description: Friedman H screen of all feature pairs in the boosted model (fatal, circumstance stage)
population: CRSS police-reported crashes (all severities, national probability sample) with a determinable maximum severity; train 2016-2021, validation 2022, test 2023-2024
method: Partial dependence on the log-odds scale over 1,000 weight-proportional 2022 crashes; pairs with Cramer's V > 0.5 (structurally dependent) or pre-specified are not carried forward
